rules.leaf: sha256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace, sig included) of each signed record whose own timestamp falls in this UTC day; for the bulk probe archives, of the signed daily manifest, which holds the sha256 of every archive part
rules.tree: RFC 6962 Merkle tree hash over the 32-byte leaf hashes: leaf node sha256(0x00||h), inner node sha256(0x01||left||right); empty tree = sha256 of empty input
rules.anchor: sha256 of canonical JSON {v, day, leaf_count, merkle_root, prev_anchor}; prev_anchor is the previous day's anchor, or the genesis anchor for the first day of the series
rules.daily_aggregate: from DAILY_AGG_FROM on, a final day also has one leaf per host: sha256 of the canonical JSON of that host's signed daily aggregate for the day (source daily_aggregate, id host|day). Its assets_seen and networks_seen fields record which stablecoin and network each host's payment requests named that day. Partial roots leave these leaves out.
rules.feed_page: from FEED_ANCHOR_FROM on (v botsrated-anchor-2), a final day also has one leaf per non-empty UTC hour of the signed event feed in R2 (feed/v1/pages/YYYY-MM-DDTHH.json): sha256 of the canonical JSON of that hourly page (source feed_page, id YYYY-MM-DDTHH). Partial roots leave these leaves out.
rules.mpp_manifest: from RAILS_ANCHOR_FROM on (v botsrated-anchor-3), a final day also has one leaf for the signed MPP challenge-check archive manifest of that UTC day (KV mpp-receipts/<day>/manifest.json), which holds the sha256 of every archive part: sha256 of its canonical JSON (source mpp_manifest). Partial roots leave it out.
rules.rail_manifest: from RAILS_ANCHOR_FROM on (v botsrated-anchor-3), a final day also has one leaf per new-rail daily manifest that exists when the day is finalized (R2 rails/<rail>/v1/days/<day>/manifest.json and the x402 per-network rollup-manifest.json): sha256 of its canonical JSON (source rail_manifest, id = R2 key). A manifest written after its day was finalized is never added to that day; it can only enter a later root as a late cover. Partial roots leave these leaves out.
rules.late_cover: a final or partial day may hold one leaf for a late-cover batch made that UTC day: sha256 of the bytes of /archive/late-cover/<day>/index.json, which lists per-day Merkle roots over signed records an earlier daily root left out (anchored late, not on their original days)

superseded_partial.note: the last partial root published for this day before it was finalized, unchanged; its leaves stay at leaves_partial_url

sources_note: Per-source record counts are not published. Each source shows whether it had records that day; leaf_count (part of the hashed head) is the number of leaves.
